title: Are you able to fly in your Mallworld type dreams?
content: I’m frequently able to fly, it’s only low to the ground, almost more like gliding. Only a few inches off the ground, but it enables me to move quickly around the mall/waterpark/surrounding streets. There’s some pattern of jumping I have to do to get the air glide going, and I sometimes can’t get right, adding to the frustration of the dream.
